overridesNotes.@esbuild-kit/core-utils>esbuild: SECURITY: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 — the esbuild dev server lets any website send requests to it and read the responses (vulnerable <=0.24.2, fixed in 0.25.0). Sole path is packages/db (devDependency) -> drizzle-kit@0.31.10 -> @esbuild-kit/esm-loader@2.6.5 -> @esbuild-kit/core-utils@3.3.2 -> esbuild, and core-utils declares ~0.18.20, so 0.25.12 is OUTSIDE the parent's declared range — a forced upgrade, not a resolution pin. No parent upgrade clears it: @esbuild-kit/* is deprecated (merged into tsx) and will not release again, and drizzle-kit 0.31.11, the latest stable, still depends on @esbuild-kit/esm-loader ^2.5.5. Safe because @esbuild-kit/core-utils only calls esbuild.transform()/transformSync()/version — never serve()/build()/context() — so the dev-server code the advisory is about is never reached, and the TS-config-loading path drizzle-kit uses works on 0.25.12. 0.25.12 is the version drizzle-kit's own ^0.25.4 already resolves, so this dedupes onto an existing copy. Dev-only. Reviewed 2026-10-01 for 3.6.0 and kept: it is one of only two overrides still load-bearing. Remove when the drizzle-kit version this repo uses no longer depends on @esbuild-kit/* (the 1.0 line drops it).
overridesNotes.esbuild@>=0.27.0 <0.28.1: SECURITY: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr — the esbuild dev server allows arbitrary file read when run on Windows (vulnerable >=0.27.3 <0.28.1, fixed in 0.28.1). Three consumers: vitest -> vite@8.1.5, which peers ^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0; tsup@8.5.1 -> bundle-require@5.1.0, which peers >=0.18; and tsup@8.5.1 itself, which DEPENDS on esbuild ^0.27.0. 0.28.1 is inside vite's and bundle-require's ranges but OUTSIDE tsup's, so for tsup this is a forced upgrade, not a resolution pin. No parent upgrade clears it: tsup 8.5.1 is the latest release and no patched 0.27.x exists — 0.27.7 is the last of that line and is vulnerable. Safe because apps/cli is the only tsup user, and `pnpm test:e2e:cli` bundles the CLI with tsup on 0.28.1 and runs the built artifact end to end. Keyed on the range rather than a bare esbuild ON PURPOSE: a flat key would also rewrite the 0.25.12 copy that drizzle-kit resolves and the @esbuild-kit/core-utils entry deliberately pins, undoing that note. Dev-only, and Windows-only while every runtime here is Linux or macOS, so this is hygiene rather than live exposure. 0.28.1 published 2026-06-11. Reviewed 2026-10-01 for 3.6.0 and kept: it is one of only two overrides still load-bearing. Remove when tsup declares a range that admits >=0.28.1 (or apps/cli moves off tsup) and vite's own peer range resolves >=0.28.1 with no override.
